kv3.1:0.1: abhidhammapiṭake kathāvatthuppakaraṇaṃ dutiyo bhāgo namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
kv3.1:1.1: tatiyo vaggo 3. 1. balakathā sa. pu. tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇanti.
kv3.1:1.3: tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakabalaṃ, sāvakabalaṃ tathāgata balanti. pa paṭi:
kv3.1:2.3: taññeva tathāgatabalaṃ taṃ sāvakabalaṃ, taññeva sāvakabalaṃ taṃ tathāgatabalanti. pa paṭi:
kv3.1:3.3: yādisaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ tādisaṃ sāvakabalaṃ, yādisaṃ sāvakabalaṃ tādisaṃ tathāgatabalanti. pa paṭi:
kv3.1:4.3: yādiso tathāgatassa pubbayogo pubbacariyā, dhammakkhānaṃ dhammadesanā, tādiso sāvakassa pubbayogo pubbacariyā, dhammakkhānaṃ dhammadesanāti. pa paṭi:
kv3.1:5.3: tathāgato jino satthā sammāsambuddho sabbaññū sabbadassāvī dhammassāmī dhammapaṭisaraṇoti.
kv3.1:5.5: sāvako jino satthā sammāsambuddho sabbaññū sabbadassāvī dhammassāmī dhammapaṭisaraṇoti. pa paṭi:
kv3.1:6.3: tathāgato anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā, maggaññū maggavidū maggakovidoti.
kv3.1:6.5: sāvako anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā maggaññū maggavidū maggakovidoti. pa paṭi:
kv3.1:8.3: hañci sāvako ṭhānāṭhānaṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe
kv3.1:9.1: sāvako atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ jānātīti. sa. paṭiññā
kv3.1:9.3: hañci sāvako atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv3.1:9.4: atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇanti.
kv3.1:10.3: hañci sāvako sabbatthagāminīpaṭipadaṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv3.1:11.3: hañci sāvako anekadhātuṃ nānādhātuṃ lokaṃ jānāti, anu, pā: tena vata re vattabbe:
kv3.1:11.4: anekadhātuṃ nānādhātuṃ lokaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇanti.
kv3.1:12.3: hañci sāvako sattānaṃ nānādhimuttikatā jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv3.1:12.4: sattānaṃ nānādhimuttikataṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇanti.
kv3.1:13.1: sāvako jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṅkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ jānātī’ti.
kv3.1:13.3: hañci sāvako jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṅkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv3.1:13.4: jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṅkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇanti.
kv3.1:14.3: hañci sāvako pubbenivāsānussatiṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv3.1:15.3: hañci sāvako sattānaṃ cutūpapātaṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv3.1:15.4: sattānaṃ cutūpapātaṃ yāthābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇanti.
kv3.1:16.1: nanu tathāgatassāpi āsavā khīṇā, sāvakassāpi āsavā khīṇā’ti.
kv3.1:16.3: atthi kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ tathāgatassa vā sāvakassa vā āsavakkhayena vā āsavakkhayaṃ, vimuttiyā vā vimuttīti.
kv3.1:16.5: hañci natthi kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ. tathāgatassa vā sāvakassa vā āsavakkhayena vā āsavakkhayaṃ, vimuttiyā vā vimutti, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv3.1:16.6: āsavānaṃ khaye yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇanti.
kv3.1:17.1: āsavānaṃ khaye yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇanti.
